title: Jade Lake Gathers the Heroes
summary: Among the dead Dragon Transformation and half-step Great Power experts, Ye Fan seals Jiang Huai'an, whose Wheel Sea is broken but Dao Palace intact, in a latrine for a hundred years. Jiang Yichen admits only that the Wanchu and Zifu Holy Sons were involved and is sealed for five hundred. The group lies low at the training ground of the leader of the 13 Great Bandits, where Nannan and Ye Fan watch the stars and talk about family. The Yaochi Holy Maiden personally invites him to the Yaochi Grand Gathering to help reseal King Stones left by the Queen Mother of the West and the Heavenly Source Master, and warns him of a secret Saint-Killing Alliance of holy-land talents. At Yaochi, the Wanchu Holy Lord (Immortal Platform) watches him, and Sheng Huangzi, the Holy Monkey, raids the peach garden for peaches to save his tribe. Master Ouyang Ye of the Source Master family seals one stone, then flees from a second, the Nine-Aperture Human Stone of the Divine race; Ye Fan seals it with the Heavenly Source technique while the Holy Monkey gives blood, despite Ouyang's sabotage of his patterns.
